fichas.title: BS standards for building materials and elements
fichas.summary: Continuation of a reference list of British Standards covering thermal insulation, natural stone cladding, waterproofing, bituminous materials, screeds, masonry, plywood and other boards, gypsum products, glazing, structural timber, wood flooring, wood-based panels, doors, and wood wool insulation products.
uses: Reference specifications and test methods for building materials and elements

fichas.title: DIN standards for building materials and elements
fichas.summary: Continuation of a reference list of DIN standards covering roof waterproofing, bitumen, floor screeds, masonry units, timber and wood products, flooring, ceramic tiles, concrete and cement products, lightweight concrete and aerated concrete elements, shotcrete, insulating plastics, plastering systems, and suspended wire-plaster ceilings.
uses: Reference specifications and test methods for building materials and elements
